reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no invalid or directionally wrong edit was introduced.

The cited Term clause (§ 12.1.1) sets a fixed, event-based expiry (last Royalty Term / lapse of the License Option) with no evergreen or automatic renewal mechanic, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift language, so any extension would require mutual written agreement — the RENEWAL preferred position.

The failed deterministic check (value=90) is a false positive: the 90 days is AbbVie's termination-for-convenience notice under § 12.3, not a non-renewal notice window, and that provision benefits our party (AbbVie/licensee), so it must not be flagged.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue; no actionable proposal is required for a compliant finding.
